description: Calibration against v2_h_frame_token (same fixture, same expected token): real Playwright navigates to the parent page, resolves the same-origin child frame from its frame tree (url contains 'frames_child'), and evaluates inside that frame to read #ctoken, which the child computes by reversing its data-src attribute ('xy9' -> '9yx'). Raw-CDP replay read the token via window.frames[0] from the parent context; divergence isolates the framework's frame enumeration/session model.
title: real Playwright child-frame evaluate on the v0.2 frames fixture
